quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Ingles on Bryce Cotton's potential as an NBA player
quotes.excerpt: When he came down here, I was like he's probably going to be one of the best

text_blocks.speaker: Pete Hooley
text_blocks.text: Did you expect him to be a six-time MVP in the NBA?

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Ingles
text_blocks.text: I knew he could play. I think with us you didn't get a ton of opportunity. He was on a non-guaranteed deal. He was a smaller guy playing against some pretty big guards. When he came down here, I was like he's probably going to be one of the best NBL players. When he signed here, I knew the NBL was in some trouble.

quotes.speaker: Joe Ingles

quotes.excerpt: I'm hoping you checked the box score and didn't check G-League.

text_blocks.speaker: Pete Hooley
text_blocks.text: What other NBL big man did you play a game with?

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Ingles
text_blocks.text: Zylan Cheatham. I played with him in January 2022. I've never played with him.

text_blocks.speaker: Pete Hooley
text_blocks.text: Dylan Windler did play for Cleveland.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Ingles
text_blocks.text: I'm hoping you checked the box score and didn't check G-League. I remember playing a minute with Dylan Windler. I don't remember playing with him. If I did, I apologize.

quotes.speaker: Joe Ingles
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Ingles on playing with Anthony Edwards and Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: We used to destroy Milwaukee when I was in Utah. Brook couldn't guard us.

text_blocks.speaker: Pete Hooley
text_blocks.text: Did you play more games with Ant or Giannis?

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Ingles
text_blocks.text: Giannis. 40 for Ant, 38 for Giannis. We used to destroy Milwaukee when I was in Utah. Brook couldn't guard us.

quotes.speaker: Joe Ingles
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Ingles on his competitive history with Chris Paul
quotes.excerpt: He hates me. I have no hard feelings, I don't really care.

text_blocks.speaker: Pete Hooley
text_blocks.text: Which player did you play against the most?

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Ingles
text_blocks.text: It has to be Denver or LA. Not my buddy Paul George. No, I left him out of this on purpose. He hates me. I have no hard feelings, I don't really care. I'm not losing sleep over him. Chris Paul, 41 games.

text_blocks.text: Rudy Gobert was number one. Mike Conley? No. Donovan Mitchell, Royce O'Neale, Bojan Bogdanovic, Ricky Rubio. Rudy Gobert was number one. Great, best pocket catching floater I've ever played with.
